verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents flows built from a trigger followed by actions that run when the flow is activated, and those flows become live once published. That covers the core 'event triggers action' mechanism, but the docs in the pack do not describe event-trigger types or conditional rule logic, and nothing independent confirms the behavior. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger types (app events or webhooks), conditional/branching rule definitions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Flow consists of two parts, trigger and actions
Actions come after the trigger and control what occurs when the flow is activated, like running code or communicating with other services.
To enable your changes, simply click on the publish button once you're done with your changes.
